params.description: Destination chain. Same as from_chain for same-chain swaps. Use chain name or ID.

params.name: to_token
params.description: Destination token — symbol or ERC-20 contract address.

params.name: from_chain
params.description: Source chain — name (ethereum, base, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, bsc, avalanche) or chain ID integer.

params.name: from_token
params.description: Source token — symbol (ETH, USDC, WBTC, USDT, MATIC, LINK) or ERC-20 contract address.

params.name: from_amount
params.description: Amount of source token to swap, in human-readable units (e.g. '0.1' for 0.1 ETH, '100' for 100 USDC). For unknown tokens, provide wei/smallest-unit string with '!' prefix (e.g. '!1000000').

tools.name: dex-trending-pools
tools.description: Trending DEX liquidity pools with buy/sell pressure data across multiple timeframes (5m, 1h, 6h, 24h). Sourced from GeckoTerminal (free, no key). Supports 100+ networks: eth, base, bsc, arbitrum, polygon_pos, solana, etc. Returns pool name, price, price change %, volume, buy vs sell transaction counts, and a buy_pressure_24h_pct metric (% of transactions that are buys — above 50% = net accumulation, below 50% = net distribution). Useful for spotting early momentum, identifying which on-chain tok

params.name: page
params.description: Page of trending pools (20 per page). Default 1, max 10.

params.name: network
params.description: Network ID to query. Common: eth, base, bsc, arbitrum, polygon_pos, solana, avax, optimism. Default: base.

params.name: buy_pressure_min
params.description: Only return pools where buy_pressure_24h_pct >= this value (e.g. 60 = at least 60% buys). Omit for no filter.

params.name: min_volume_usd_24h
params.description: Filter pools with less than this 24h volume. Default 10000.

tools.name: dictionary-intel
tools.description: English word lookup: definitions (up to 4 per part of speech), phonetic transcription, audio pronunciation URL, synonyms, antonyms, and example sentences. Supports multiple parts of speech per word (noun, verb, adjective, etc.). Useful for writing agents, NLP preprocessing, vocabulary enrichment, content generation, and semantic pre-flight checks. No API key required.

params.name: lang
params.description: Language code. Currently 'en' is best supported. Default: en.

params.name: word
params.description: English word to look up (e.g. 'serendipity', 'run', 'ephemeral'). Single word or compound (e.g. 'machine learning').

tools.name: dividend-calendar
tools.description: Upcoming dividend ex-dates from NASDAQ — all stocks going ex-dividend on a given date (default: today) or in the next 1–7 days. Returns symbol, company name, ex-date, record date, payment date, dividend amount, and annual indicated dividend. $0.008/call.

params.name: date
params.description: Target date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Default: today (UTC).

params.name: days_ahead
params.description: Fetch dividends for this many calendar days starting from `date`. Default: 1 (single day). Max: 7.

params.name: min_dividend
params.description: Filter: minimum dividend amount per share (USD). Default: no filter.

tools.name: dividend-intel
tools.description: Full dividend intelligence for any US equity: trailing 12-month yield, forward annual rate, payout frequency (monthly/quarterly/semi-annual/annual), 5-year dividend CAGR, consecutive years paid, consecutive years of growth, and complete 5-year dividend history with dates and amounts. Single call — no API key. Ideal for income screening, dividend safety analysis, and yield comparison across a portfolio.

params.name: ticker
params.description: US stock ticker (e.g. AAPL, JNJ, KO, T, SCHD). Case-insensitive.

tools.name: dns-lookup
tools.description: DNS record lookup for any domain via Cloudflare DoH. Supports A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CNAME, NS, SOA, CAA, or ALL record types. TXT lookups include SPF/DMARC/DKIM email security signal extraction. Useful for domain audits, email configuration verification, CDN setup checks, and infrastructure reconnaissance.

params.name: type
params.description: DNS record type to query. 'ALL' queries A, MX, TXT, NS, and CNAME in parallel and returns all results. Default: 'A'.

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain name to look up (e.g. 'github.com', 'mail.google.com').

tools.name: document-qa-prep
tools.description: Prepares a document for question-answering and RAG pipelines. Chunks the input text at paragraph/sentence boundaries, assigns deterministic chunk IDs, estimates token counts, and extracts document metadata (word count, type, headings). Returns ready-to-embed chunks with overlap support. No LLM or external API — pure text processing. Use mid-task when you've fetched a document and need it split before querying a vector store.

params.name: text
params.description: Document text to prepare (plain text, Markdown, or lightly-structured prose). Max 500,000 chars.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Optional key-value metadata to attach to every chunk (e.g. source URL, document ID).

params.name: overlap_tokens
params.description: Token overlap between consecutive chunks for context continuity (default 50, max 512).

params.name: chunk_size_tokens
params.description: Target chunk size in tokens (default 512, max 4096). Uses 4-char-per-token estimate.

tools.name: domain-availability
tools.description: Check domain name availability across multiple TLDs (com, net, org, io, ai, co, app, dev by default). Returns per-TLD availability status, registrar, and expiry for registered domains. Uses RDAP — authoritative registry data, no API key. Ideal for brand research, startup naming, and domain portfolio work.

params.name: name
params.description: Base domain name to check, without TLD (e.g. 'acme', 'my-startup'). Can also be a full domain like 'acme.com' — the TLD will be stripped and checked alongside others unless tlds is set.

params.name: tlds
params.description: List of TLDs to check (without dot). Defaults to: com, net, org, io, ai, co, app, dev. Max 10.
